observations.behavior: Changes the Metronome connector's configuration and checkpoint. It replaces a page-based coalesce cap with a row-based cap, and adds a concurrency and rate-limit hold configuration. It also changes the checkpoint to include a next_page cursor and a customer-specific cursor, and the request window. No request or pagination implementation is shown.
